name: io.github.ethereaglehq/privatools
title: PrivaTools
description: Stateless privacy-first PDF, image, document, and media processing tools via PrivaTools API.

environmentVariables.name: PRIVATOOLS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional PrivaTools API key from privatools.me for authenticated higher-quota access

environmentVariables.name: PRIVATOOLS_MCP_ALLOWED_DIRS
environmentVariables.description: Optional OS path-delimited directory allowlist for local file reads and writes

environmentVariables.name: PRIVATOOLS_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional PrivaTools-compatible API v1 base URL (defaults to https://api.privatools.me/api/v1)
